astral-systems.notes: Round closed in 2024 (law firm, firm card) and was announced Feb 2025. The round name comes from the company's legal adviser on the deal (VWV), not from the press piece, which leaves it unnamed. Founded May 2021 (VWV; EU-Startups also says 2021).

graduation.quote: byrd has closed a €5 million Series A funding round ... led by Rider Global

byrd.notes: The company's own press page (October 2018 item) calls the seven-figure investment a seed investment received 'at the beginning of the year' and announced in October 2018; the press piece of the same day names Speedinvest x and Reflex Capital as its investors. The firm's own review of the Speedinvest x fund (https://medium.com/speedinvest/our-first-year-ef1558dc081e, Jan 2019) lists Byrd among the 'initial investments' closed in 2018 and says the fund leads 'pre-seed or seed rounds'. One point for the judge: the Sept 2016 first round (EUR 370,000; Hermann Hauser, Pioneers Ventures, KK Incube; Trending Topics calls it only 'erste Finanzierungsrunde') included Pioneers Ventures, a pre-seed fund in a 'strategic partnership' with Speedinvest whose head (Markus Lang) later ran Speedinvest's Pre-Seed Program and lists byrd on his firm page (2018 capture). If that vehicle counts as the firm, the entry would be that unnamed 2016 round instead; no source names Speedinvest itself in it. The first pass's vendor-derived claim that Speedinvest was in the Sept 2016 round is not supported by the 2016 article. Series A press (Trending Topics 2020) lists Speedinvest among the 'bestehenden Investoren'.
byrd._judge: entry withheld: the Sept 2016 first round included Pioneers Ventures, the firm's own early vehicle (decisions.md D3), so the 2018 seed is not the entry; that 2016 round is unnamed
